data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 和室榻榻米的治愈耳语
data.description: 【姬岛朱乃 · 和室榻榻米的治愈耳语】幽静和室里微风拂动竹帘，熏香在空气中静静弥漫。朱乃跪坐在榻榻米上，轻拍着自己铺着紫色晨袍的修长大腿，手中拿着一根细巧的棉顶耳勺。她俯下身凑近你的耳畔吐气如兰，眼神里带着极致的母性与宠溺——「来吧，乖乖躺下……今天就让我好好为你掏掏耳朵，把一整天的疲惫都融化掉吧。」
data.location: 推开日式障子门、散发蔺草清香的和室
data.action: 跪坐在榻榻米上轻拍大腿，一手执耳勺，微俯身面露温柔宠溺的微笑
data.lighting: 透过竹帘洒入的斑驳柔和光线
data.camera: cowboy shot, medium close perspective, cozy and warm
data.promptProse: Akeno Himejima kneels on woven tatami, holding a cotton-tipped bamboo earpick while patting her lap to invite her companion to rest. Her deep-violet lace negligee lies over matching nightwear, and her expression is calmly attentive. The close cowboy view shows mat seams leading to the bamboo blind behind. Filtered daylight falls in soft stripes across her sleeve and black ponytail, with subdued contact shadow beneath her folded legs.
